listing.name: Sagitarius Concordat
listing.summary: The 1.1 version of the mod is here, it comes with 4 new ship, a new hullmod, balance changes and a description for every large ballistic, enjoy.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique ships and weapons, centered around the philosophy of equality among individuals.

description:
Welcome to the Concordat, Strafarer.Welcome to the Sagitarius Concordat — a group of spacers united under the shared belief that every individual stands equal, regardless of their origins or convictions.

This faction is designed to be played exclusively with its own ships and weapons, though you are of course free to do as you please. Fair warning: balancing will be somewhat rough around the edges, so expect things to swing between extremely overpowered and underwhelming. Feel free to share any ideas or suggestions you'd like to see implemented in this thread or on the unofficial discord!

aiDescription: Adds a new faction called the Sagitarius Concordat, featuring a distinct set of ships and weapons designed around the theme of equality among all individuals. The faction is intended to be played exclusively with its own content, though players are free to customize their experience. Balancing is still in development, with some units expected to be overpowered or underpowered.
